The strongest adverse evidence is credible reporting of unlawful killings, disappearances, torture, arbitrary detention, protest repression, journalist attacks, and weak accountability, alongside executive-backed National Guard militarization and transfer toward Defense Ministry control (E010, E021, E046, E047, E048, E054). Presidential stigmatization of feminist protesters and critical civil society is directly attributable, but the projection does not establish that rhetoric caused physical attacks or that AMLO ordered specific abuses (E049, E051). Counterweights include generally respected peaceful assembly with exceptions, an Ayotzinapa truth process, expanded disappearance transparency, and active constitutional review by courts (E010, E022, E023, E047, E055). Federalism, criminal actors, inherited crisis conditions, and incomplete remedy outcomes limit attribution.
